services.name: Waverunner Rentals
services.desc: Starting at $69 About >Located in beautiful Madeira Beach and Treasure Island, Florida at John's Pass, there is no easier way to rent a waverunner. Less than a minute from the Gulf of Mexico, you board your waverunner from the safety of our dock in the calm waters of the pass. Watch the dolphins and manatee play as you taxi a very short distance to the Gulf of Mexico, where you can open that throttle up and really enjoy the power of our newer Yamaha models. We keep our equipment in top running condition with a dedication to your enjoyment. All prepared by a knowledgeable staff with a Starting at $69 · 1& 2 Hour · 14+ to Operate (w/legal guardian) · 18+ to Rent · Max 400lbs

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: >Hey, Capt. Kellen here. We take a lot of pride in our fishing and love providing plenty of fish for when we come back to the dock. 8 hour trips are our favorite for Grouper, Snapper, Amberjacks, and often pelagic fish such as King Fish, Cobia, Mahi-Mahi, and Wahoo. If we don't come back with fish, your trip is Free. Lady Godiva offers fishing charters inshore, near shore, off shore, and deep sea. Guaranteed to catch fish! Maximum 6 passangers per boat, Multiple boat charters available. Everything provided included licenses, bait, tackle, gear and ice We suggest you bring a small cooler

quotes.text: We just rented three jet skis for 2 adults, 2 teens and 2 kids. What a great time!! Well organized and informative. Had a clean bathroom and multiple lockers to keep our things. Jet skis were in excellent condition and easy to use. We recommend to anyone of any age!!

The BEST place on John’s Pass to go jet skiing. We have come here time and time again and every time it’s better than the last. The staff are extremely friendly and helpful and go the extra mile to ensure you have the most enjoyable time! I cant wait to come back!
